audit.whatIsWrong: Nevermove and Vision of Empire have their slot letters swapped throughout content: prose repeatedly says "Nevermove (W)" and "Vision of Empire (E)", but the kit (and packet enemyAbilities) has W = Vision of Empire and E = Nevermove. wants.foe[1] also attributes the pull-in effect to "Ravenous Flock (E-recast)" when Ravenous Flock is Swain's passive (P) — the pull is Nevermove's second cast.
audit.why: Getting the slot wrong tells the reader the wrong cooldown class and the wrong order abilities come online, which matters for exactly this kind of CC-dodging matchup.
audit.corrected: Swapped the (W)/(E) tags on every Nevermove/Vision of Empire mention in content, and renamed the pull-in effect to Nevermove (E-recast).

audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[4].side (Level 6) reads 'Swain' while content.win[4] reads 'Skill' and phases[4].why itself argues the silence/burst favours Blitzcrank, not Swain — the row contradicted its own text.
audit.why: whys[4] in content explicitly frames level 6 as a wash where ult timing decides it (Skill), matching win[4]; phases[4].why describes Blitzcrank's silence finishing the combo, not Swain winning the exchange.
audit.corrected: Set phases[4].side to Skill to match win[4] and the why text; no win[N] edit needed since win[4] already read Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Nevermove (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s — the real cooldown that governs when the root is down.

edits.before: Even at 2 it's a coin flip: your Overdrive all-in wants to land, but Swain's Nevermove (W) root and Vision of Empire (E) can catch you first if you facecheck, so respect his range.
edits.after: Even at 2 it's a coin flip: your Overdrive all-in wants to land, but Swain's Nevermove (E) root and Vision of Empire (W) can catch you first if you facecheck, so respect his range.

edits.before: This is a pure skill lane from level 1: both of you want to land your point-and-click-adjacent CC first. You threaten Rocket Grab (Q), but Swain's Nevermove (W) is a delayed AoE root that punishes you if you Grab into it, and his Vision of Empire (E) zones your step-ups. At 2 you can all-in with Overdrive (E) plus Power Fist (W), but only if you've dodged his root — otherwise he roots and kites you. Don't facecheck brush; the player who lands their skillshot first wins the trade.
edits.after: This is a pure skill lane from level 1: both of you want to land your point-and-click-adjacent CC first. You threaten Rocket Grab (Q), but Swain's Nevermove (E) is a delayed AoE root that punishes you if you Grab into it, and his Vision of Empire (W) zones your step-ups. At 2 you can all-in with Overdrive (E) plus Power Fist (W), but only if you've dodged his root — otherwise he roots and kites you. Don't facecheck brush; the player who lands their skillshot first wins the trade.
